decisions.reason: Transactional email is the flagship of the firm's cloud enterprise messaging strategy and benefits from growing digital business processes, so it stays and keeps being developed.
Document capture supports the firm's electronic document workflow direction and digitization demand, although its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 adds some uncertainty.
Email and fax conversion is cheap to run on existing infrastructure and is still used by regulated sectors such as healthcare, even though fax demand is slowly declining.
Sandbox threat protection meets rising demand for email security against ransomware and phishing, which is central to the firm's secure messaging offer.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a core layer of the email security service, so withdrawing it would weaken the main offering.
